data.one_liner: Flutter searchable dropdown widget supporting pagination, future requests, and form fields.
data.what_it_does: Provides a searchable dropdown widget with built-in support for pre-set items, future requests, and paginated data loading. It also includes form field compatibility for easy validation and saving.
use_when: You need a dropdown widget with an integrated search bar.
You need to load dropdown items via pagination or future asynchronous requests.
avoid_when: You only need a standard, non-searchable Material dropdown.
strengths: Supports paginated and future-loaded item lists
Form field integration with validation and saving support
Includes customizable display options like hints, margins, and decorations
weaknesses: Limited to dropdown and form field use cases
